title: The Cruel Queen and the Fiance
overview: The queen announces Pride's engagement on her 16th birthday. It may seem like the perfect match, but Pride knows it's anything but a fairy tale.

title: The Cruel Queen Speaks
overview: Pride knows what lies in store for Leon, and she is determined to safeguard her fiance's happiness. However, Pride's friends worry that she isn't safeguarding her own.

title: The Cruel Queen and the Truth
overview: Pride will not suffer a conspiracy aimed at Prince Leon.

title: The Cruel Queen Makes a Declaration
overview: With Leon and the Anemone Kingdom destined to fall into ruin, Pride confronts the conspirators directly.

title: The Cruel Queen Takes Notice, and is Noticed
overview: With the engagement behind her, Pride faces the future with what her evil counterpart never had: people who care for her.

title: The Audacious Queen and Alcohol
overview: Roles and priorities may change, but that doesn't mean bonds disappear.

title: The Cruel Queen and Alliance Negotiations
overview: According to the game, Prince Cedric is meant to be Tiara's future fiancé. But the script changes when he sets his eyes on Pride instead.

title: The Diabolical Princess and the Fool
overview: Cedric doesn't understand how close he is to causing an international incident. Pride may not like him, but she can't allow such a mistake to happen.

title: The Cruel Princess and the Request
overview: The Kingdom of Copelandii will invade sooner than expected.

title: The Cruel Princess and the Second-born Prince
overview: Cedric is wracked with guilt over the crisis facing his country, but Pride assures him that the future isn't set in stone.

title: The Blasphemous Princess Prepares Herself
overview: When tensions between allied kingdoms rise, Pride must cross a closed border to discover the reason why.

title: The Blasphemous Princess Takes a Stand
overview: Three nations unite after Pride gambles with her life and vows to protect her allies.
